frozen.classes: chord (two branch points, chord2's class), arc (arcjump's stepped arc, w = 1,2,1,2, log branch points on the arc), smooth (the arc with w = 1, the plant arc's class, context)
frozen.errors: part 1: measured rel_k, k <= 22 (floor 1e-30), F = 1; part 2: #670's model (measured for k <= 22, log-linear extrapolation on k = 18..22 beyond), F = 1
frozen.twin_size: M_min (least squares, chi <= 1) and M_lo (l2 <= sqrt(n)); the smallest twin lies in [M_lo, M_min]
frozen.C0_same_class: chord2 in the chord basis, arcjump in the arc basis, the plant arc in the smooth basis, each at M = 6, n = 23: chi <= 1e-30 at every node
frozen.C1_precision: at M_min - 1 and M_min of every scan, chi at 250 digits agrees with 150 digits within 1e-3 relative
frozen.C1_amended_672: #672, the coordinator's amendment, frozen before the rerun of twins and twins_real: at M = n, C1 passes when chi <= 1e-30 at both 150 and 250 digits; below n it is unchanged. Why: at M = n the twin is the interpolant and chi is rounding noise at both precisions, so their relative difference is undefined. A check fit that mpmath finds singular counts as chi = inf
frozen.mutation_C1_672: --mutate=c1dup (twins_real only): column n - 1 of the 250-digit bases is replaced by column n - 2, so the 250-digit fit cannot interpolate at M = n. It must make the amended C1 fire on every scan with M_min = n and leave the scans with M_min < n passing; the run does not stop on a firing, judges C1 only, and exits 1
frozen.C2_reproduce: the chord twin of arcjump at n = 23 has M_min = 19 at every node (#670); a failure is a discrepancy, reported
frozen.both_ways: the arc twin of chord2 counts as a twin (not an interpolant) if M_min <= n - 1 = 22; its M_min and gap n - M_min are reported per node
frozen.mutation_twins: --mutate=arccol (arc column m = 0, order 20, x (1 + 1e-8)) must make C0 arc fail at every node, --mutate=chordcol the same for C0 chord; each run exits 1
frozen.twins_real: only if C0 and C1 pass on the plants; per node M_min and M_lo of the chord, arc and smooth twins of the real sigma_0..sigma_22 (J1250); C1 on the real fits stops the work if it fires; a class is read as preferred by term count only if its M_min is smaller by at least 3 at every node (reported); J1500 at wf 1.00 is context
frozen.size: N = ||c||_2 of the chord twin with M_SIZE = 40 terms, minimised exactly subject to chi <= 1; bracket [N_lo, N_hi] from the barrier (explicit twin) and its dual; targets chord2, arcjump, arc; n = 23, 31; every node
frozen.S_gap: N_hi / N_lo - 1 <= 1e-4 for every target, n and node
frozen.S_valid: the explicit twin's chi recomputed at 250 digits with the 250-digit basis <= 1 + 1e-6, and N_lo recomputed at 250 digits with the same multipliers within 1e-6 relative
frozen.S0_calibration: chord2's smallest twin within 10% of chord2's own size N_own (its 6-term coefficients): N_lo >= 0.9 N_own and N_hi <= 1.1 N_own at n = 23 and 31 and every node
frozen.mutation_size: --mutate=scale (chord2's sigma_k x 1.25, its errors kept) must make S0 fail at every n and node; the run exits 1
frozen.separation: at n = 31, rho_hi = N_hi(arcjump) / N_lo(chord2) and rho_lo = N_lo(arcjump) / N_hi(chord2): if rho_hi <= 3 at every node, no size prior separates them (the answer); if rho_lo > 3 at every node, a size prior of factor 3 separates them; otherwise mixed. n = 23 is reported the same way
frozen.size_real: only if S_gap, S_valid and S0 pass and rho_lo > 3 at every node at n = 23: the real series' smallest chord twin at n = 23, rho_real = N(real) / N(chord2) per node, read against 3; otherwise no real size run
frozen.context: the ridge route's smallest ||c|| with chi <= 1, the peak density and largest |c_m| of each smallest twin, N at M = 50 (wf 1.00) against M = 40, and the plant arc's N; reported, not judged
